method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live from a europa.eu origin page, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. 12 of 18 candidates in this window returned HTTP 200 with exact title matches and were filled. Six postings returned HTTP 404 (dead postings) and were skipped without a fill: 34fa127a204990c7 (NL, Logistiek tussenjaar); 358946229163faf4 (FI, Varastotyöntekijä Kerava); 358a8bcf93e98d3b (NL, Magazijnmedewerker avond Eindhoven (publications-60743-C)); 36250ffc0319a87a (FR, Employé / Employée de rayon produits alimentaires (H/F)); 3626fb3c4c653c57 (FI, Varastotyöntekijä urheiluvaatevarastolle, Hyvinkää, Hyvinkää); 36790a875e0c138f (PL, Magazynier (K/M)) - the dead-link sweep owns pruning. All fills carry expected_source_id pins (guard shipped 2026-11-22).
